title: BTA! Additional Tooltips
description: Adds more information to item tooltips like food regen, armor protection values, tool & arrow damage, tool mining efficiency, item durability and map and flag art.
body:
BTA! Additional Tooltips is a client side mod for 8.0 BTA! that adds more information to item tooltips in an unobtrusive way.

It adds the following information:
- Food regeneration amounts and how long the regen lasts for.
- Armor protection values, for both human and wolf armor.
- Tool & Arrow damage values.
- Tool mining efficiency.
- Item durability, unlike the vanilla durability display it shows Quiver and Paintbrush values properly.
- A display for map and flag art.

Information can be toggled on how it displays, or whether it should even show up on a new page in the Options menu.
